newsitem.title: UK: Brazil, Thailand feature in sugar freight business.
newsitem.headline: Brazil, Thailand feature in sugar freight business.

text.p: Brazil and Thailand featured among Wednesday's reported business on the sugar freight market but activity was generally routine, shipbrokers said.
Brazilian shippers SIMAB quoted for a 14,000-tonne bagged cargo from Recife to Lagos for mid-March.
Cargill quoted for 12,000 tonnes of sugar from Thailand to Indonesia or the Philippines for the end of March and also amended one of its previous orders.
It specified just Puerto Quetzal as an origin for a prompt 14,000-tonne bulk cargo to be shipped to Morocco with options of Black Sea, Egyptian Mediterranean and lower Baltic options.
E D & F Man was said to have fixed two 14,000-tonne cargoes of bagged sugar but details of the rates have yet to emerge.
Man was firm with a cargo from Thailand to Colombo/Pakistan for March 20/25 and also from Acajutla to Colombo for mid-March dates, shipbrokers said.
Tate & Lyle was thought to be close to fixing its recent order from Barbados to London for March dates but no further details were immediately available.
